claims.gist: Digital economy is approaching a critical tipping point
By 2023 over half of global GDP comes from digitally transformed enterprises
Enterprises unable to compete digitally will lose core markets
A new species of enterprise will be required to compete
Enterprises will accelerate investment to become hyperspeed, hyperscaled, hyperconnected
By 2023 over 50% of ICT spend goes to transformation, from 27%
Enterprises will shift traditional ICT to cloud for efficiency
Digital services must be able to run anywhere and anytime
By 2022, 70% of enterprises will integrate public and private clouds
Edge deployment reasons shifting toward critical activities
By 2023 over half of new infrastructure at edge, up from 10%
By 2024 edge apps will increase 800%
Digital innovation factory is core to competitive differentiation
By 2025 two thirds of enterprises will be prolific software producers
By 2023 over 500 million cloud-native apps will be deployed
Most new apps will target industry-specific transformation
App explosion will set new minimum competitive requirements
By 2025 at least 90% of new enterprise apps embed AI
Disruptive AI-led apps will be about 10% of apps by 2025
By 2024 over 50% of UI interactions use AI-enabled vision or speech
AI's impact on enterprises is hard to overstate

thesis: By 2023 digital transformation will dominate the economy, forcing enterprises into hyperscaled, cloud, edge and AI-driven operating models.
